description: Portrait of Todd Webb looking  at the camera with a smile. He is standing in the courtyard of the Abiquiu house leaning against a wooden post, wearing a light colored shirt, a watch, and a light meter cord around his neck, his hand and arm are on his chest. The sleeves of his shirt are rolled up and in the two breast pockets are a pen and a small case, most likely a light meter case.
title: Todd Webb
